b:
"Anger should cool."
This is the outpouring
of my helplessness

I tried and failed,
like a man without a spine

Smiles to my face,
jeers behind my back

Talk when they need something,
then a drama of silence

No thanks at all,
in the middle of foxes

I asked for help;
the hands I thought of
did not reach out

When I sat broken,
those mouths were not there
even to say a word

The question
"Why me?"

ends up as
"Why
only me?"

You can only reap
what you sow

Did I too
forget
to sow love?

I do not know;
this
anger that will not cool
is against
myself
note: "Anger should cool" (āṟuvatu ciṉam) is a line from Avvaiyar's Aathichoodi, a book of one-line maxims every Tamil child learns.
